name: Quote
summary: A testimonial or citation: the quotation in the display face, a chrome mark and the source in a caption.

guidance.useFor: A client's words about working with you, or a citation worth setting apart.
insteadUse: Repeating a line from the article: Pull quote
A short quotation inside a sentence: <q>
content: Real quotes only, with the person's permission
The caption names the person, then their role and organisation

rungReason: <figure>, <blockquote> and <figcaption> tie the quotation to its source natively.

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

rules: The large quotation mark is decorative (aria-hidden); the blockquote is the quotation
The avatar is decorative: the name is written beside it
forcedColors: The mark in CanvasText; the avatar Canvas with a border
